content: वैहार्य {%a.%} To be sported with, to be made the subject of jokes or pleasantry (said of the brother of oneʼs wife or of the wifeʼs relatives in general); यथा बालेषु नारीषु वैहार्येषु तथैव च . संकरेषु निपातेषु तथापद्व्यसनेषु च . अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे … <ls>Mb.</ls> .{@-र्यम्@} Sportiveness, fun.
